clue.text: Climber making use of tourist's transport

definitions.meaning: a climbing plant, the wild clematis of hedgerows
read literally, the delight a traveller feels

explanation.surface: A mountaineer enjoys travelling as a tourist does.
explanation.walkthrough: 'making use of' is only a link between the two senses; the second reading is a playful literal take on the plant's name.
explanation.definitionFit: The wild clematis is a hedgerow climbing plant known by this common name.

clue.text: TV series, a runaway success?

definitions.meaning: an American television drama about a man on the run
literally, someone who has succeeded in running away

explanation.surface: A television show that became a hit.
explanation.definitionFit: A long-running American drama series, and literally an escapee is one who has got away successfully.

clue.text: From the first, a lot of Hawaiians are so welcoming?

definitions.text: From the first, a lot of Hawaiians are so welcoming?

indicators.note: the opening letter of each following word is taken, starting from the first

explanation.surface: Most Hawaiians are friendly to visitors.
explanation.definitionFit: The Hawaiian word is used as a greeting of welcome and farewell.

clue.text: Not at first agree stage production's a seasonal treat

indicators.note: production is: a staged production remakes the letters
the word agree is used without its opening letter

explanation.surface: Someone at first refuses to agree that a stage show is a festive treat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Not at first' drops the A from agree, leaving GREE; with STAGE this is rearranged, signalled by 'production's'.
explanation.definitionFit: A chocolate egg given at Easter is a classic seasonal confection.

clue.text: Characters in literature

definitions.meaning: as in 'a man of ...', learning and writing

explanation.surface: Figures appearing in novels.
explanation.definitionFit: Alphabetic symbols are characters, and the word also means learning or literary culture.

clue.text: Fellow runs to top of mountain, getting hot

indicators.note: in this down clue the runs letter goes at the top, above the mountain

parts.note: R is the cricket abbreviation for runs
an alp is a high mountain
H is the abbreviation for hot, as on taps

explanation.surface: A man hurries up a peak and gets warm.
explanation.definitionFit: A man's first name, so a fellow, a chap.

clue.text: Singular garments bound to fit son

parts.note: to bound is to leap or jump
to fit is to suit
S is the abbreviation for son in genealogy

explanation.surface: Unusual clothes are sure to suit a boy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Singular' looks like 'odd', but it means each garment is a single one-piece item.
explanation.definitionFit: One-piece outfits covering body and legs, each a single garment.

clue.text: That tycoon is oddly deficient

indicators.note: the word tycoon loses its odd-placed letters, keeping the even ones

explanation.surface: A rich businessman is strangely lacking.
explanation.definitionFit: Old or dialect demonstrative meaning that one over there.

clue.text: Emperor's refusal to entertain monarch

indicators.note: the refusal word hosts, holding the monarch inside

parts.note: no is a refusal
ER, Elizabeth Regina, the Queen

explanation.surface: An emperor declines to host a king.
explanation.definitionFit: A Roman emperor notorious for cruelty; the clue's 's is read as 'is'.

clue.text: Resolution of dispute in colony

definitions.meaning: a place where people have settled

explanation.surface: Ending a quarrel within a colony.
explanation.definitionFit: An agreed end to a quarrel, and also a community founded by settlers.

clue.text: South American chap's seen a disaster

parts.note: a guy is a chap; the 's is read as 'has'

indicators.note: the words seen a are wrecked into a new order

explanation.surface: A man from South America has witnessed a catastrophe.
explanation.definitionFit: A native of Guyana, a country on South America's north coast.

clue.text: Horse approaching Russia once, bearing a cavalryman

parts.note: horse is slang for heroin, abbreviated H

indicators.note: the old state carries the letter a inside it

parts.note: the former Soviet Union, USSR

explanation.surface: A horseman rides towards old Russia carrying something.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Horse' suggests the cavalry mount, but it is drug slang giving H.
explanation.definitionFit: A light cavalry soldier, originally of Hungarian regiments.

clue.text: Pilot a plane, falsely giving name

indicators.note: the letters of pilot a plane are set out wrongly, rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone flies an aircraft under a false name.
explanation.definitionFit: A formal word for a name or title.

clue.text: Popular holiday period the main one, though short

parts.note: the main is poetic for the open ocean, the high seas

indicators.note: the word one is cut short, losing its last letter

explanation.surface: Peak tourist time is a primary one, if brief.
explanation.walkthrough: 'the main' is the old poetic word for the open sea; 'one, though short' gives ON.
explanation.definitionFit: The busiest time of year for tourism, when prices peak.

clue.text: Who'll provide mostly domestic help, having secured employment?

definitions.text: Who'll provide mostly domestic help, having secured employment?

indicators.note: the pieces hold the employment word fast inside them
the word for domestic loses its last letter

parts.note: domestic as in home
use is employment
aid is help

explanation.surface: A job seeker who will do household chores after landing a post.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue doubles as the definition: a job seeker who, once hired, gives household help. 'provide' is only a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: A woman servant employed to do household work, a domestic helper.

clue.text: Club supplying men on board, say, with cannabis

indicators.note: the chessmen's name is spoken, giving a word that sounds the same

parts.note: chess pieces called knights are men on a chessboard
pot is slang for cannabis

explanation.surface: A club providing sailors with drugs.
explanation.walkthrough: 'men on board' suggests sailors, but the board is a chessboard.
explanation.definitionFit: A nightclub, a place for evening entertainment.

clue.text: Policeman seized by two armed warriors

indicators.note: the policeman is held inside the two

parts.note: II is two in Roman numerals
MP is Military Police, a military policeman

explanation.surface: Two armed fighters grab an officer.
explanation.definitionFit: A Zulu regiment or band of warriors.

clue.text: Aborigine given top mark in university

parts.note: A is the top grade

explanation.surface: A native student gets the best grade at college.
explanation.definitionFit: The indigenous people of northern Japan, original inhabitants of the region.

clue.text: Agrees gala can be organised as a fund-raising event

indicators.note: the letters of agrees gala are put into a different arrangement

explanation.surface: A committee agrees a gala can be arranged as a charity occasion.
explanation.definitionFit: A sale of unwanted household goods, often held to raise money.

clue.text: Trainer hauled up Chelsea's top pair after second fixture?

indicators.note: in a down clue, pulled upward, so the trainer word is read bottom to top

parts.note: a tamer trains animals

indicators.note: the first two letters of Chelsea

explanation.surface: A coach drags up Chelsea's best two after a moment.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Trainer' suggests a football coach; it is an animal tamer, turned to REMAT.
explanation.definitionFit: A replay of a game is a second fixture between the same sides.

clue.text: Cut non-specialised classes

indicators.note: the word for non-specialised is shortened by its last letter

parts.note: general means not specialised

explanation.surface: Trimming broad categories.
explanation.definitionFit: Biological classification groups, plural of genus.

clue.text: Park keeper blows his top --' displaying this?

definitions.text: Park keeper blows his top --' displaying this?

indicators.note: the keeper's word loses its first letter

parts.note: a ranger looks after a park

explanation.surface: A ranger loses his temper and shows it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'blows his top' both drops the first letter and describes the emotion shown.
explanation.definitionFit: Losing one's temper displays fury or rage.

clue.text: Friend offered foreign coin for fabric

parts.note: a mate is a friend
the rial is the currency of Iran and other countries

explanation.surface: A pal pays in foreign money for cloth.
explanation.definitionFit: Cloth or textile is material.

clue.text: Right page can be found in middle of phone book

indicators.note: only the central letters of the directory word are kept

parts.note: a telephone directory

explanation.surface: The right page can be found halfway through the telephone listings.
explanation.walkthrough: 'middle of' keeps the centre of DIRECTORY, dropping DI and RY.
explanation.definitionFit: The right-hand page of an open book is the recto.

clue.text: Shortest way to the top, believe me

explanation.surface: A climber insists the quickest route is vertical.
explanation.definitionFit: Vertically upward is the shortest route, and also a colloquial assurance of honesty.

clue.text: Piece of meat trimmed at the edges for a light meal

indicators.note: the meat word loses its first and last letters

parts.note: a steak is a piece of meat

explanation.surface: A cut of beef with the fat trimmed for a snack.
explanation.definitionFit: An afternoon or early evening snack or meal.

clue.text: Announce punishment for killer

indicators.note: the punishment word is spoken, giving a name that sounds alike

parts.note: a caning is a school punishment

explanation.surface: Declare the penalty for a murderer.
explanation.definitionFit: In Genesis, the first murderer, who killed his brother Abel.

clue.text: The last word on reformed soccer team

indicators.note: the letters of the last word on are formed afresh

explanation.surface: The final say on a reorganised football club.
explanation.walkthrough: Aldershot is a garrison town in Hampshire, England; its football club bears this name.
explanation.definitionFit: An English football club based in the Hampshire army town.
